description: Composite, ledger-indexed snapshot of ASTEROID: supply (outstanding, escrowed, total, circulating), AMM liquidity and trading fee, LP-lock accessibility assessed from live control paths, project-declared treasury escrows, and trust-line/holder counts. Enveloped with per-section provenance and degraded codes. Observation of ledger state only — not a quote, not a market evaluation and not transaction preparation.
